def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # A 3x3 ring with a central 2 marks an arrow source; draw arrow in direction
    # of the repeated 2-line grid axis. Existing 2 lines define lattice separators.
    # Determine axis by rays of 2s extending from marker's center.
    markers=[]
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w-2):
            if all(grid[r+i][c+j]==(2 if (i,j)==(1,1) else 3) for i in range(3) for j in range(3)):
                markers.append((r+1,c+1))
    for r,c in markers:
        # Find nearest horizontal and vertical separator rows/cols, choose direction
        # toward the farther endpoint / long open corridor as arrow orientation.
        rows=[i for i in range(h) if grid[i][c]==2]
        cols=[j for j in range(w) if grid[r][j]==2]
        # Boundary lattice bars: direction points away from nearest bar edge.
        # use distances to nearest separator above/below and left/right
        up=max([i for i in rows if i<r], default=-1)
        dn=min([i for i in rows if i>r], default=h)
        lf=max([j for j in cols if j<c], default=-1)
        rt=min([j for j in cols if j>c], default=w)
        # select vertical/horizontal axis via longer unobstructed interval
        if max(r-up,dn-r)>=max(c-lf,rt-c):
            dr=-1 if r-up>dn-r else 1
            # arrow body centered on column, arrowhead points dr
            for k in range(1, min(r-up,dn-r)+1):
                rr=r+dr*k
                if 0<=rr<h and out[rr][c]==0: out[rr][c]=1
            tip=r+dr*min(r-up,dn-r)
            for dc in (-1,0,1):
                cc=c+dc
                if 0<=tip<h and 0<=cc<w and out[tip][cc]==0: out[tip][cc]=1
        else:
            dc=-1 if c-lf>rt-c else 1
            for k in range(1,min(c-lf,rt-c)+1):
                cc=c+dc*k
                if 0<=cc<w and out[r][cc]==0: out[r][cc]=1
            tip=c+dc*min(c-lf,rt-c)
            for dr2 in (-1,0,1):
                rr=r+dr2
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=tip<w and out[rr][tip]==0: out[rr][tip]=1
    return out
